Change it

Make the sentence negative, or change the time as shown.

  1. Mia was watching a horror film. → Mia a horror film.
  2. The girls were sleeping at midnight. → The girls at midnight.
  3. Tom played a joke on Sofia. → Tom a joke on Sofia.
  4. I'm chilling at home right now. (at 9 pm yesterday) → At 9 pm yesterday I at home.
  5. They're gossiping in the group chat. (last night) → Last night they in the group chat.
  6. Is Emma laughing? (when the mask appeared) → when the mask appeared?
  7. We scroll on our phones. (when the phone rang) → We on our phones when the phone rang.

Listening – Judy the babysitter

Listen to track 24 for A. Then listen to track 25 for B and C. Listen again for D.

Track 24

A · Track 24 – put the events in order (1–5)

  1. a The phone rang – a wrong number.
  2. b Judy turned on the TV and started an old romantic film.
  3. c A man said: “Go check on the baby.”
  4. d Mrs Donovan said the baby was asleep.
  5. e Judy ran upstairs. The cot was empty!
Track 25

B · Track 25 – true or false? Type T or F.

  1. Mrs Donovan's phone wasn't working.
  2. Timmy was in his cot.
  3. The caller was John, Judy's boyfriend.
  4. Mrs Donovan was angry with Judy.

C · Who said it? Judy, the man, Mrs Donovan or the narrator?

  1. “Oh well, suit yourself.”
  2. “Go check on the baby.”
  3. “This is so not funny!”
  4. “Her boyfriend John was probably playing a joke.”
  5. “It's just his idea of a joke.”
  6. “The baby's already asleep.”
